5.title: 6 IPOs to Watch in 2025 | Morningstar UK
5.content:
6 ipos to watch in 2025 
 ai and fintech companies are among the names expected to ride a renewed wave of ipos this year . 
 sarah hansen 
 23 jan 2025 
 investors could have a host of newly minted stocks to choose from in 2025 with the market for initial public offerings heating up . 
 the roster of expected ipos in 2025 includes several high - profile financial technology stocks and artificial intelligence plays . pitchbook analysts predict some 20 unicorns — private companies valued at more than $ 1 billion — could come to market in 2025 under ideal conditions . 
 this week could bring the first big ipo of the year with the listing of natural gas exporter venture global . the firm will seek a valuation of up to $ 65 billion—a blockbuster debut and one sign that a long - awaited ipo rebound could be underway . 
 among the other big ipos that could hit the market in 2025 : 
 chime 
 klarna 
 medline industries 
 sailpoint technologies 
 cerebras systems 
 coreweave 
 “there ’s already big ipos coming to market , ” says angelo bochanis , an ipo data and index associate at renaissance capital . “it ’s just a question of the speed and the scale of the ipo recovery . ” 
 top ipos to watch in 2025 
 analysts credit the rosy outlook for ipos in 2025 to a potent combination of factors . stocks are entering the third year of a bull market , the economy is poised to keep growing , and investors are optimistic that the federal reserve will continue cutting interest rates , even if the scope of those cuts may be smaller than previously expected . 
 2024 brought more ipo activity than the two previous years , but it still felt short of a typical year . this year could be another story . “ we believe the rebound in 2024 , coupled with a better macro backdrop , is the start of another multiyear period of ipo value exceeding $ 50 billion annually , ” pitchbook private equity analysts wrote last year . 
 some names are already generating buzz . market watchers are keeping a close eye on fintech firms and ai plays , as well as more established private companies with proven track records of success . here are six ipo candidates investors should watch in 2025 . 
 chime and klarna 
 mobile banking firm chime is among the buzzi est ipo candidates for the year ahead . the firm is valued at $ 25 billion , according to pitchbook , and it has raised more than $ 2 . 6 billion in venture capital funding since it was founded over a decade ago . 
 the company filed confidentially for an ipo at the end of last year , according to media reports . duncan davidson , a general partner and cofounder of bullpen capital , is looking at the firm as a litmus test for the success of other ipos in the coming year . “ if it goes out early and does well , it ’s a really good bellwether , ” he says . 
 two of chime ’s peers in fintech , klarna and stripe , are also on the short list for ipos this year . sweden - based klarna , a buy - now / pay - later company , has filed to list its ipo in the united states . pitchbook pegs klarna ’s most recent valuation at $ 6 . 7 billion . 
 “ it ... looks like the kind of company that would attract a lot of interest , in terms of being kind of a tech ipo , but could also stand to benefit from sustained consumer spending , ” says bochanis . 
 medline industries 
 medline , a medical supply firm based in illinois , is another candidate for a blockbuster ipo in 2025 . medline was acquired by its current private equity owners — blackstone , carlyle , and hellman & friedman — in 2021 . 
 the firm was last valued at more than $ 42 billion , according to pitchbook , and analysts at renaissance capital predict it could raise some $ 50 billion in an ipo . bochanis says medline stands apart from other likely entrants into the market because of its size and age . “it ’s a mature business , ” he says . “they ’re one of the biggest players in the field . ” medline filed confidentially for an ipo in december , reuters reported . 
 sailpoint technologies 
 founded in 2004 , sailpoint is a cyber security firm that develops identity governance software for businesses . the company is owned by the private equity firm thoma bravo , which took it private in 2022 in a $ 6 . 9 billion deal , according to pitchbook . the firm was last valued at $ 8 . 5 billion . it filed publicly for an ipo earlier this month , and it plans to list on the nasdaq exchange under the ticker sail . 
 cerebras systems 
 california - based cerebras is capturing the attention of investors looking for the next big ai play . cerebras designs chips and software that power ai applications . davidson likens the firm to semiconductor giant nvidia nvda . “it ’s a pure - play ai chip thing , ” he says . the firm is currently valued at $ 4 . 25 billion and backed by multiple venture capital investors , according to pitchbook . it filed with the sec for a public listing on the nasdaq in september . 
 coreweave 
 a larger player in the ai space is cloud infrastructure firm coreweave , which is valued at $ 23 billion and has raised $ 1 . 6 billion from venture capital investors , according to pitchbook . bochanis says coreweave ’s business model of renting hardware to other businesses could make its public debut especially compelling . “it ’s a way for a lot of smaller companies to access the power that they need for really intensive ai uses … i tcouldattractalotof in terestfrominvestorsth at are  lookingfornew a ip lay s,”hes ays . 
 headwinds and tailwinds for ipos in 2025 
 filling the sails of the ipo market in the year ahead is clarity surrounding the incoming trump administration , which market watchers expect to be friendlier to corporate america . “there ’s a sense of optimism amongst the investor community that … i t’llbeeas ie rtogetdealsdone,”saysmikebellin,iposervicesleaderatpwcus.“allofthatbodeswellforpotentialinvestorsandiposasriskierassets…youhavemorecertaintyaroundwheretheadministrationisgoing,andwedidn ’ tnecessari ly hav e that in th epast. ” 
 that ’s not to mention the force of momentum from 2024 . “ under the surface , there ’s a belief in the ecosystem that the market will open up , ” says davidson . 
 pitchbook analysts find that historically , that momentum tends to build after a few slow years . “ we are encouraged by the observation that ipo activity , after a sharp decline , often has a three - to five - year run of strength , ” they wrote recently . 
 but the policy landscape in 2025 will also bring uncertainties for investors , and those uncertainties could put a dent in ipo activity . bellin points to the threat of lingering inflation , which could force the fed to leave interest rates higher for longer . that could weigh on investor confidence and the ipo market . rising bond yields and heightened volatility in fixed - income markets are also on investors ’ radar . 
 ipo backlog 
 2025 ’s ipo market won’t just be fintech and ai . there are 170 companies in the public ipo pipeline , according to data from renaissance capital , and more than 200 companies in the “ shadow backlog ” that could list within the next two years , according to the firm ’s estimates . 
 “there ’s a lot of built - up supply on the ipo side , ” says bell in . given the slowdown in ipos in 2022 and 2023 , market watchers say that older , more valuable startups that stayed private longer than they otherwise would have could begin to hit public markets this year . in 2025 , bellin expects ipo prospects to be broadly distributed across sectors , but he points specifically to ongoing momentum from the life science and pharma industries . 
 and of course , big tech is not going anywhere . “there ’s a lot of excitement , ” bellin says , though he believes many ai companies are too early in their lifecycles to list this year . “ we ’ ll see some activity in that space in 2025 but i think there ’s probably room to grow for many of those organizations ” before they list , he adds . 
 if markets continue to cheer the prospect of lower rates , pitchbook ’s venture capital analysts note that “ we should see more risk appetite enter public markets , enticing tech companies with the idea that now is better than never . ” 
 bellin says energy and renewables companies could see more momentum as the ai industry continues to generate more demand for power , and adds that consumer companies could also continue to thrive .

6.title: Les IPO à venir en 2025 à ne pas manquer
6.content:
les ipo à venir en 2025 à ne pas manquer 
 avril 9 , 2025 
 · 14 min · muhammad ijaz 
 le marché des ipo se prépare pour une année passionnante alors que 2025 promet une liste d’entreprises de haut profil se préparant à entrer en bourse . des innovateurs en ia aux pionniers de l’énergie verte et aux géants de la technologie de consommation , les investisseurs surveillent de près . ici , nous mettons en avant certaines des ipo les plus attendues de 2025 et pourquoi elles pourraient façonner l’avenir des marchés publics . 
 1. stripe 
 stripe , fondée en 2010 par les frères patrick et john collison , est devenue une pierre angulaire de l’industrie fintech en fournissant des solutions complètes de traitement des paiements en ligne . la plateforme de l’entreprise permet aux entreprises de toutes tailles d ’ accepter des paiements , de gérer leurs revenus et d ’ étendre leurs opérations à l’échelle mondiale . au fil des ans , stripe a acquis une base de clients substantielle , y compris des géants de l’industrie comme amazon , google et bmw , soul ignant son rôle essentiel dans l’économie numérique . 
 en février 2025 , stripe a annoncé une offre publique d’achat permettant aux employés actuels et anciens de vendre des actions , valorisant l’entreprise à 91,5 milliards de dollars . cette valorisation reflète une reprise significative par rapport à une valorisation interne précédente de 50 milliards de dollars en 2023 , la rapprochant de sa valorisation maximale de 95 milliards de dollars en 2021 . l ’ offre publique d’achat a non seulement fourni de la liquidité aux employés , mais a également indiqué la santé financière robuste et la trajectoire de croissance de stripe . en 2024 , l’entreprise a traité environ 1,4 trillion de dollars en volume total de paiements , marquant une augmentation de 38 % par rapport à l’année précédente . 
 malgré sa croissance impression nante et sa valorisation substantielle , stripe n’a pas encore fait de mouvements définitifs vers une offre publique . la direction de l’entreprise a maintenu une approche prudente , choisissant de rester privée tout en se concentrant sur l’expansion de ses offres de produits et de sa portée mondiale . cette stratégie permet à stripe d ’ opérer sans les pressions et le contrôle qui accompagnent souvent les cotations sur les marchés publics . alors que le paysage fintech continue d ’ évoluer , l ’ ipo potentielle de stripe reste un sujet d’intérêt pour les investisseurs et les observateurs de l ’ industrie , qui la considèr ent comme un événement significatif pouvant redéfinir la perception des entreprises fintech sur le marché public . 
 2. spacex 
 spacex , sous la direction d ’ elon musk , a considérablement transformé le secteur aérospatial avec ses technologies innovantes et ses projets ambitieux . un projet notable est starlink , une filiale axée sur la fourniture d’internet à large bande mondial via une constellation de satellites en orbite terrestre basse . à la fin de 2024 , starlink avait lancé environ 6 000 satellites , fournissant des services internet à 4,6 millions d ’ abonnés dans 75 pays . 
 malgré l’expansion impression nante et le succès financier de starlink , des discussions sur une éventuelle offre publique initiale ( ipo ) sont en cours . elon musk a indiqué qu’une ipo serait envisa gée une fois que starlink atteindra it un flux de trésorerie prévisible et une stabilité financière . au début de 2025 , aucune date officielle n’a été annoncée , mais la forte croissance et la rentabilité de l’entreprise suggèrent qu’une ipo pourrait être à l ’ horizon , attirant un intérêt significatif tant des investisseurs de détail que des investisseurs institutionnels . 
 3. databricks 
 databricks , réputée pour sa plateforme d ’ analytique big data et alimentée par l ’ ia , est un candidat à l ’ ipo de premier plan pour 2025 . en décembre 2024 , l’entreprise a levé 10 milliards de dollars lors d’un tour de financement de série j , portant sa valorisation à 62 milliards de dollars . cet investissement substantiel souligne la forte croissance de databricks et son rôle essentiel dans l’industrie des données et de l ’ ia . l’entreprise dispose d’une solide base de clients , servant plus de 10 000 organisations dans le monde entier , y compris plus de 60 % des entreprises du fortune 500 , avec des clients notables tels que block , comcast , rivian et shell . 
 4. shein 
 shein , le géant de la mode rapide fondé en chine et maintenant basé à singapour , poursuit activement une offre publique initiale ( ipo ) , avec des plans de cotation à la bourse de londres dès avril 2025 . 
 cependant , les ambitions d ’ ipo de shein ont rencontré plusieurs défis . en février 2025 , des rapports ont indiqué que shein était sur le point de réduire sa valorisation à environ 50 milliards de dollars , soit près d’un quart de moins que sa valeur de levée de fonds en 2023. cette réduction est attribuée à des vents contraires croissants , y compris la suppression potentielle de l ’ exemption de droits “ de minimis ” aux états - un is , ce qui pourrait affecter la rentabilité de shein sur son plus grand marché . 
 le contrôle réglementaire s’est également intensifié . l ’ autorité de conduite financière du royaume - uni ( fca ) prend plus de temps que d ’ habitude pour approuver l ’ ipo de shein , se concentrant sur la supervision de la chaîne d ’ approvisionnement de l’entreprise et évaluant les risques juridiques . cela fait suite à des défis de groupes de défense , tels que stop uyghur genocide , qui allèguent que la chaîne d ’ approvisionnement de shein comprend du coton produit par le travail forcé des ouïghours . 
 de plus , shein a été critiquée pour ses pratiques de travail . en 2024 , l’entreprise a signalé avoir trouvé deux cas de travail des enfants dans sa chaîne d ’ approvisionnement , impliquant des mineurs âgés de 11 ans et huit mois , et de 15 ans et trois mois . shein a mis fin aux relations avec les fournisseurs impliqués et a souligné son approche de tolérance zéro envers le travail des enfants . 
 malgré ces défis , shein continue d ’ attirer l’attention pour sa croissance rapide et son modèle commercial axé sur le numérique , séduisant particulièrement les consommateurs de la génération z. cependant , les investisseurs potentiels sont conseillés de prendre en compte le contrôle réglementaire et éthique en cours , qui pourrait affecter la performance du marché de l’entreprise et sa perception publique . 
 5. plaid 
 fondée en 2013 par zach perret et william hockey , plaid s’est imposée comme un acteur clé de l ’ écosystème fintech en fournissant des api qui permettent aux applications de se connecter sans effort aux comptes bancaires des utilisateurs . cette infrastructure est devenue essentielle pour une multitude de services financiers , y compris la gestion des finances personnelles , le prêt et les paiements . 
 en avril 2025 , plaid a complété un tour de financement de 575 millions de dollars , ce qui a valu à l’entreprise 6,1 milliards de dollars , soit significativement moins que sa valorisation de 13 , 4 milliards de dollars en 2021 . cette réduction reflète les tendances du marché plus larges où les valorisations fintech ont été impacté es par des taux d’intérêt plus élevés et un contrôle accru des investisseurs . notamment , le tour de financement a attiré de nouveaux investisseurs tels que franklin templeton , fidelity management and research et blackrock , aux côtés de bailleurs de fonds existants comme nea et ribbit capital . 
 plaid a diversifié ses offres de produits au-delà de ses services de liaison bancaire de base . l’entreprise s’est aventurée dans des domaines tels que les solutions anti - fraude , la vérification d ’ identité et la facilitation des paiements . ces nouvelles lignes de produits représentent désormais plus de 20 % des revenus annuels récurrents ( arr ) de plaid et connaissent une croissance rapide : les services anti-fraude ont connu une augmentation annuelle de 400 % , tandis que la facilitation des paiements a augmenté de 250 % . 
 concernant les plans d ’ offre publique , plaid a indiqué qu’une ipo fait partie de sa stratégie à long terme mais n’a pas fixé de calendrier spécifique . en avril 2025 , l’entreprise a déclaré qu’elle ne deviendra it pas publique dans l’année mais continue de suivre une voie vers une cotation éventuelle . 
 la trajectoire de plaid souligne le paysage en évolution de la fintech , où les entreprises doivent naviguer dans les fluctuations du marché , les considérations réglementaires et l’impératif d ’ in nover en permanence . son rôle dans la facilitation de la banque ouverte et de la finance intégrée en fait une entité significative à surveiller dans les années à venir . 
 6. impossible foods 
 impossible foods , fondée en 2011 , a été un pionnier dans l’industrie de la viande à base de plantes , offrant des produits conçus pour reproduire le goût et la texture de la viande traditionnelle . le produit phare de l ’ entreprise , le burger impossible , a gagné une traction significative , menant à des partenariats avec de grandes chaînes de restauration rapide et une distribution dans de nombreux supermarchés . en 2021 , impossible foods explorait des options pour entrer en bourse , envisage ant une offre publique initiale ( ipo ) ou une fusion avec une société d’acquisition à vocation spéciale ( spac ) , visant une valorisation d ’ environ 10 milliards de dollars . 
 cependant , en avril 2024 , la trajectoire de l’entreprise avait changé . le pdg peter mcguinness a indiqué qu ’ impossible foods visait un “ événement de liquidité ” dans les deux à trois prochaines années , ce qui pourrait inclure une ipo , une vente ou des efforts de levée de fonds supplémentaires . cet ajustement reflète les dynamiques évolutives du marché de la viande à base de plantes , où les entreprises font face à des défis tels que la fluctuation de la demande des consommateurs et une concurrence accrue . au début de 2025 , bien qu ’ impossible foods continue d ’ élargir ses offres de produits et sa présence sur le marché , le moment exact et la nature de son entrée publique restent in certains , en faisant une entreprise à surveiller dans les années à venir . 
 7. klarna 
 klarna , le puissant fintech suédois renommé pour ses services “ acheter maintenant , payer plus tard ” ( bnpl ) , a été une force transformative dans le paysage mondial des paiements depuis sa création en 2005 . en permettant aux consommateurs d ’ effectuer des achats et de différer les paiements , klarna a exploité un marché en pleine expansion de consommateurs recher chant des solutions de paiement flexibles . l ’ approche innovante de l’entreprise a non seulement attiré une base d ’ utilisateurs substantielle , mais a également suscité des partenariats avec plus de 575 000 commerçants dans 26 pays . 
 en novembre 2024 , klarna a déposé confidentielle ment une demande d ’ offre publique initiale ( ipo ) auprès de la securities and exchange commission des états - un is , signalant son intention de se coter à la bourse de new york sous le symbole “ klar ” . à ce moment - là , l’entreprise envisageait une valorisation d ’ environ 20 milliards de dollars , un ajustement notable par rapport à sa valorisation maximale de 45 , 6 milliards de dollars en 2021 . 
 cependant , le chemin vers une entrée en bourse a été semé d ’ embûches . au début d ’ avril 2025 , dans un contexte de tensions commerciales mondiales croissantes et de l ’ imposition de tarifs importants par l ’ administration américaine , klarna a décidé de mettre en pause ses plans d ’ ipo . les conditions de marché volatiles , exacerbé es par des craintes de récession et des mesures de rétorsion de la part des partenaires commerciaux , ont poussé l’entreprise à réévaluer son calendrier . 
 malgré ces revers , la santé financière de klarna reste robuste . l’entreprise a signalé une augmentation de 24 % de ses revenus , reflétant son expansion continue et la popularité croissante des services bnpl . de plus , klarna a été proactive dans l ’ utilisation de l’intelligence artificielle pour améliorer l ’ efficacité opérationnelle , réd ui sant notamment sa main-d’œuvre grâce à des solutions de service client alimenté es par l ’ ia . 
 alors que klarna navigue dans les complexités du paysage économique actuel , son éventuelle entrée publique est très attendue . la capacité de l’entreprise à s’adapter aux dynamiques du marché , couplée à son engagement envers l ’ innovation , la positionne comme un acteur redoutable dans le secteur fintech . les investisseurs et les observateurs de l’industrie suivront de près les mises à jour sur le parcours d ’ ipo de klarna , reconnaissant son potentiel à influencer significativement l’avenir des paiements numériques . 
 8. chime 
 chime , fondée en 2012 par chris britt et ryan king , a rapidement émergé comme un acteur de premier plan dans le secteur de la banque numérique en offrant des services financiers sans frais , centrés sur le mobile . l ’ approche innovante de l’entreprise a attiré une base de clients substantielle , avec plus de 22 millions d ’ utilisateurs à la fin de 2024 . le succès de chime est largement attribué à sa plateforme conviviale , qui propose des fonctionnalités telles que le dépôt direct anticipé , l ’ épargne automatisée et l’absence de frais bancaires traditionnels , ré sonnant particulièrement avec les jeunes générations à la recherche de solutions bancaires pratiques et économiques . 
 en décembre 2024 , chime a déposé confidentielle ment une demande d ’ offre publique initiale ( ipo ) , visant à entrer en bourse en 2025 . l’entreprise était valori sée à 25 milliards de dollars en 2021 après avoir sécurisé 750 millions de dollars lors d’un tour de financement de série g dirigé par sequoia capital . cependant , au début d ’ avril 2025 , chime , ainsi que d ’ autres entreprises technologiques comme klarna et stubhub , a décidé de mettre en pause ses plans d ’ ipo en raison de la volatilité du marché et de l ’ incertitude des investisseurs dé coulant de nouveaux tarifs annoncés et de tensions commerciales mondiales croissantes . malgré ces défis , chime continue de se concentrer sur l’expansion de ses offres de produits et l ’ amélioration de l’expérience client , se position nant comme un acteur significatif dans le passage en cours de la banque traditionnelle aux services financiers axés sur le mobile . 
 9. medline industries 
 medline industries , fondée en 1966 par les frères james et jon mills , est devenue un fabricant et distributeur mondial de premier plan de fournitures médicales , offrant un portefeuille étendu d ’ environ 335 000 produits . l’entreprise opère dans plus de 100 pays et territoires , soutenue par une main-d’œuvre de plus de 43 000 employés dans le monde entier . en 2024 , medline a rapporté des ventes nettes de 25,5 milliards de dollars , marquant plus de 50 années consécutives de croissance des revenus . 
 en décembre 2024 , medline a déposé confidentielle ment une demande d ’ offre publique initiale ( ipo ) aux états - un is , visant à lever plus de 5 milliards de dollars . ce mouvement pourrait potentiellement valoriser l’entreprise à environ 50 milliards de dollars . l ’ ipo était anticipée pour se produire dès le deuxième trimestre de 2025 , en fonction des conditions du marché . 
 cependant , en avril 2025 , medline , ainsi que d ’ autres entreprises telles que klarna et stubhub , a décidé de reporter ses plans d ’ ipo en raison de la volatilité du marché dé coulant de nouveaux tarifs annoncés et de tensions commerciales mondiales croissantes . cette décision reflète l ’ approche prudente de l’entreprise pour naviguer dans des paysages économiques in certains . 
 la trajectoire de croissance constante de medline et sa présence mondiale expansive soulignent son rôle significatif dans le secteur de la santé . le potentiel d ’ entrée publique de l’entreprise reste un point focal pour les observateurs de l’industrie et les investisseurs , car cela pourrait représenter l ’ une des ipo les plus substantielles dans l’industrie des fournitures médicales ces dernières années . 
 qu’est-ce qui rend ces ipo remarquables ? 
 ces entreprises se distinguent par leur forte notoriété de marque , leur croissance rapide des revenus et leur leadership dans l ’ industrie . de plus , beaucoup opèrent dans des secteurs à forte croissance comme la fintech , l ’ ia , la technologie spatiale et l’énergie verte , des domaines prisés par les investisseurs institutionnels et de détail . 
 tendances clés stimulant l ’ activité des ipo en 2025 
 plusieurs tendances macroéconomiques accélèrent le pipeline des ipo . celles-ci incluent la normalisation des taux d ’ intérêt , l ’ amélioration de la stabilité du marché et la demande refoulée des entreprises qui ont retardé leur entrée en bourse pendant la récession de 2022 - 2023 . l ’ appétit des investisseurs revient , en particulier pour les modèles commerciaux évolutifs et axés sur la technologie . 
 conseils aux investisseurs : que surveiller dans les ipo 
 lors de l ’ évaluation des ipo à venir , considérez la performance financière , la taille du marché , l’avantage concurrentiel et l’expérience de la direction . lisez attentivement le dépôt s - 1 , en vous concentrant sur la croissance des revenus , la trajectoire de rentabilité et tout risque juridique ou réglementaire . 
 risques à garder à l’esprit 
 toutes les ipo ne sont pas des gagnantes garanties . le timing du marché , les valorisations élevées et les modèles commerciaux non prouvés peuvent poser des risques . par exemple , certains licornes ont déçu les investisseurs après leur ipo en raison de bénéfices faibles ou de chemins peu clairs vers la rentabilité . 
 l’impact sur les marchés plus larges 
 les ipo de haut profil ont tendance à stimuler le sentiment du marché et peuvent entraîner une augmentation de l ’ activité de trading dans tous les secteurs . une ipo réussie de stripe ou spacex pourrait faire grimper les valorisations dans les industries fintech ou spatiales , respectivement . 
 le retour du boom des ipo technologiques ? 
 après une année 2022 lente et une période prudente en 2023 - 2024 , les ipo technologiques semblent prêtes pour un grand retour . avec l ’ intérêt croissant pour l ’ ia , l ’ automatisation , l’infrastructure cloud et les paiements numériques , 2025 pourrait marquer le retour d’un boom des ipo à grande échelle . 
 esg et préparation à l ’ ipo 
 les facteurs environnementaux , sociaux et de gouvernance ( esg ) sont de plus en plus importants pour les investisseurs en ipo . des entreprises comme impossible foods et shein font face à un examen minutieux non seulement pour leur croissance , mais aussi pour leur approvisionnement éthique , leurs émissions et leur responsabilité sociale . 
 cotations internationales et intérêt américain 
 certaines entreprises peuvent choisir des cotations internationales en raison de facteurs réglementaires ou politiques , mais les bourses américaines comme le nasdaq et le nyse restent très attractives . les investisseurs américains devraient également surveiller les ipo transfrontalières offrant une exposition mondiale . 
 conclusion 
 2025 s ’ annonce comme une année exceptionnelle pour les ipo , avec de nombreuses entreprises définissant l’industrie se préparant à entrer en bourse . pour les investisseurs , cela représente à la fois une opportunité et un défi : la chance d ’ investir dans les géants de demain , mais aussi la nécessité de diligence raisonnable et de gestion des risques . restez informé , lisez attentivement les dépôts et considérez la valeur à long terme plutôt que le battage médiatique à court terme .

7.title: Le principali IPO in arrivo nel 2025 che non dovresti perdere
7.content:
le principali ipo in arrivo nel 2025 che non dovresti perdere 
 aprile 9 , 2025 
 · 13 minuti · muhammad ijaz 
 il mercato delle ipo si sta preparando per un anno emozionante , poiché il 2025 promette una serie di aziende di alto profilo pronte a diventare pubbliche . da innovatori dell ’ ia a pionieri dell ’ energia verde e giganti della tecnologia dei consumatori , gli investitori stanno osservando da vicino . qui evidenziamo alcune delle ipo più attese del 2025 e perché potrebbero plasmare il futuro dei mercati pubblici . 
 1. stripe 
 stripe , fondata nel 2010 dai fratelli patrick e john collison , è diventata una pietra miliare nell ’ industria fintech fornendo soluzioni complete per l ’ elaborazione dei pagamenti online . la piattaforma dell ’ azienda consente alle imprese di tutte le dimensioni di accettare pagamenti , gestire le entrate e espandere le proprie operazioni a livello globale . nel corso degli anni , stripe ha acquisito una base clienti sostanziale , inclusi giganti del settore come amazon , google e bmw , sottolineando il suo ruolo fondamentale nell ’ economia digitale . 
 nel febbraio 2025 , stripe ha annunciato un ’ offerta pubblica di acquisto che consente ai dipendenti attuali e passati di vendere azioni , valu tando l ’ azienda a 91,5 miliardi di dollari . questa valutazione riflette un significativo recupero rispetto a una precedente valutazione interna di 50 miliardi di dollari nel 2023 , avvicinandosi alla sua valutazione massima di 95 miliardi di dollari nel 2021 . l ’ offerta non solo ha fornito liquidità ai dipendenti , ma ha anche indicato la solida salute finanziaria e la traiettoria di crescita di stripe . nel 2024 , l ’ azienda ha elaborato circa 1,4 trilioni di dollari in volume totale di pagamenti , segnando un aumento del 38 % rispetto all ’ anno precedente . 
 nonostante la sua impressionante crescita e la valutazione sostanziale , stripe non ha ancora fatto mosse definitive verso un ’ offerta pubblica . la leadership dell ’ azienda ha mantenuto un approccio cauto , optando per rimanere privata mentre si concentra sull ’ espansione delle proprie offerte di prodotti e sulla portata globale . questa strategia consente a stripe di operare senza le pressioni e il controllo che spesso accompagnano le quotazioni nei mercati pubblici . con l ’ evoluzione del panorama fintech , la potenziale ipo di stripe rimane un argomento di grande interesse tra gli investitori e gli osservatori del settore , che la vedono come un evento significativo che potrebbe ri modellare la percezione del mercato pubblico delle imprese fintech . 
 2. spacex 
 spacex , sotto la guida di elon musk , ha trasformato significativamente il settore aerospaziale con le sue tecnologie innovative e progetti ambizio si . un ’ iniziativa notevole è starlink , una sussidiaria focalizzata sulla fornitura di internet a banda larga globale tramite una costellazione di satelliti in orbita terrestre bassa . entro la fine del 2024 , starlink aveva lanciato circa 6.000 satelliti , fornendo servizi internet a 4,6 milioni di abbonati in 75 paesi . 
 nonostante l ’ impressionante espansione e il successo finanziario di starlink , le discussioni su una potenziale offerta pubblica iniziale ( ipo ) sono in corso . elon musk ha indicato che un ’ ipo sarebbe presa in considerazione una volta che starlink raggiunga un flusso di cassa prevedibile e stabilità finanziaria . all ’ inizio del 2025 , non è stata annunciata alcuna data ufficiale , ma la robusta crescita e la redditività dell ’ azienda suggeriscono che un ’ ipo potrebbe essere all ’ orizzonte , at tirando un notevole interesse sia da parte degli investitori al dettaglio che istituzionali . 
 3. databricks 
 databricks , rinomata per la sua piattaforma di analisi dei big data e basata sull ’ ia , è un candidato ipo di spicco per il 2025 . nel dicembre 2024 , l ’ azienda ha raccolto 10 miliardi di dollari in un round di finanziamento di serie j , elevando la sua valutazione a 62 miliardi di dollari . questo investimento sostanziale sottolinea la robusta crescita di databricks e il suo ruolo fondamentale nell ’ industria dei dati e dell ’ ia . l ’ azienda vanta una solida base clienti , serven do oltre 10.000 organizzazioni in tutto il mondo , inclusi più del 60 % delle fortune 500 , con clienti notevoli come block , comcast , rivian e shell . 
 4. shein 
 shein , il gigante della fast fashion fondato in cina e ora con sede a singapore , sta attiva mente per seguendo un ’ offerta pubblica iniziale ( ipo ) , con piani per quotarsi alla borsa di londra già ad aprile 2025 . 
 tuttavia , le ambizioni di ipo di shein hanno incontrato diverse sfide . nel febbraio 2025 , rapporti indi cavano che shein era pronta a ridurre la sua valutazione a circa 50 miliardi di dollari , quasi un quarto in meno rispetto al valore di raccolta fondi del 2023. questa riduzione è attribuita a crescenti difficoltà , inclusa la potenziale rimozione dell ’ esenzione doganale “ de minimis ” negli stati uniti , che potrebbe influenzare la redditività di shein nel suo mercato più grande . 
 il controllo normativo si è intensificato . l ’ autorità di condotta finanziaria del regno unito ( fca ) sta impie gan do più tempo del solito per approvare l ’ ipo di shein , concentrando si sulla supervisione della catena di approvvigionamento dell ’ azienda e valu tando i rischi legali . ciò segue le sfide da parte di gruppi di advocacy , come stop uyghur genocide , che sostengono che la catena di approvvigionamento di shein include cotone prodotto da lavoro forzato degli uiguri . 
 inoltre , shein ha affrontato critiche per le pratiche lavorative . nel 2024 , l ’ azienda ha segnalato di aver trovato due casi di lavoro minorile nella sua catena di approvvigionamento , coinvolgendo minori di 11 anni e otto mesi e 15 anni e tre mesi . shein ha interrotto i rapporti con i fornitori coinvolti e ha sottolineato il suo approccio di tolleranza zero verso il lavoro minorile . 
 nonostante queste sfide , shein continua ad attirare attenzione per la sua rapida crescita e il modello di business digitale , che attrae particolarmente i consumatori della gen z. tuttavia , si consiglia ai potenziali investitori di considerare il controllo normativo e etico in corso , che potrebbe influenzare le prestazioni di mercato dell ’ azienda e la percezione pubblica . 
 5. plaid 
 fondata nel 2013 da zach perret e william hockey , plaid si è affermata come un attore fondamentale nell ’ ecosistema fintech fornendo api che consentono alle applicazioni di connettersi senza problemi ai conti bancari degli utenti . questa infrastruttura è diventata essenziale per una miriade di servizi finanziari , inclusi la gestione delle finanze personali , il prestito e i pagamenti . 
 nel aprile 2025 , plaid ha completato un round di finanziamento di 575 milioni di dollari , che ha valutato l ’ azienda a 6,1 miliardi di dollari , significativamente inferiore alla sua valutazione di 13 , 4 miliardi di dollari nel 2021 . questa riduzione riflette le tendenze di mercato più ampie in cui le valutazioni fintech sono state influenza te da tassi di interesse più elevati e un maggiore controllo da parte degli investitori . è importante notare che il round di finanziamento ha attratto nuovi investitori come franklin templeton , fidelity management and research e blackrock , insieme a sostenitori esistenti come nea e ribbit capital . 
 plaid ha diversificato le sue offerte di prodotti oltre i suoi servizi principali di collegamento bancario . l ’ azienda si è avventurata in aree come soluzioni antifrode , verifica dell ’ identità e facilitazione dei pagamenti . queste nuove linee di prodotto ora rappresentano oltre il 20 % delle entrate ricorrenti annuali ( arr ) di plaid e stanno vivendo una rapida crescita : i servizi antifrode hanno visto un aumento annuale del 400 % , mentre la facilitazione dei pagamenti è cresciuta del 250 % . 
 per quanto riguarda i piani di offerta pubblica , plaid ha indicato che un ’ ipo fa parte della sua strategia a lungo termine , ma non ha fissato un calendario specifico . nel aprile 2025 , l ’ azienda ha dichiarato che non sarebbe diventata pubblica entro l ’ anno , ma continua a seguire un eventuale quotazione . 
 la traiettoria di plaid sottolinea il panorama in evoluzione del fintech , dove le aziende devono navigare tra fluttuazioni di mercato , considerazioni normative e l ’ imperativo di innovare continuamente . il suo ruolo nel facilitare l’open banking e la finanza integrata la posiziona come un ’ entità significativa da tenere d ’ occhio nei prossimi anni . 
 6. impossible foods 
 impossible foods , fondata nel 2011 , è stata una pioniera nell ’ industria della carne vegetale , of frendo prodotti progettati per replicare il gusto e la consistenza della carne tradizionale . il prodotto di punta dell ’ azienda , l’impossible burger , ha guadagnato un notevole successo , portando a partnership con importanti catene di fast food e distribuzione in numerosi negozi di alimentari . nel 2021 , impossible foods stava esplorando opzioni per diventare pubblica , considerando un ’ offerta pubblica iniziale ( ipo ) o una fusione con una società di acquisizione per scopi speciali ( spac ) , puntando a una valutazione di circa 10 miliardi di dollari . 
 tuttavia , ad aprile 2024 , la traiettoria dell ’ azienda era cambiata . il ceo peter mcguinness ha indicato che impossible foods stava puntando a un “ evento di liquidità ” entro i prossimi due o tre anni , che potrebbe includere un ’ ipo , una vendita o ulteriori sforzi di raccolta fondi . questo aggiustamento riflette le dinamiche in evoluzione del mercato della carne vegetale , dove le aziende affrontano sfide come la domanda dei consumatori in fluttuazione e la crescente concorrenza . all ’ inizio del 2025 , mentre impossible foods continua ad espandere le sue offerte di prodotti e la sua presenza sul mercato , il momento esatto e la natura del suo debutto pubblico rimangono incerti , rendendo la un ’ azienda da tenere d ’ occhio nei prossimi anni . 
 7. klarna 
 klarna , il potente fintech svedese noto per i suoi servizi “ compra ora , paga dopo ” ( bnpl ) , è stata una forza trasformativa nel panorama globale dei pagamenti sin dalla sua nascita nel 2005 . consentendo ai consumatori di effettuare acquisti e posticipare i pagamenti , klarna ha sfruttato un mercato in espansione di acquirenti in cerca di soluzioni di pagamento flessibili . l ’ approccio innovativo dell ’ azienda ha non solo attratto una base utenti sostanziale , ma ha anche attratto partnership con oltre 575 . 000 commercianti in 26 paesi . 
 nel novembre 2024 , klarna ha presentato in modo riservato una domanda per un ’ offerta pubblica iniziale ( ipo ) presso la securities and exchange commission degli stati uniti , segna lando la sua intenzione di quotarsi alla borsa di new york con il simbolo “ klar ” . a quel tempo , l ’ azienda stava contemplando una valutazione di circa 20 miliardi di dollari , un notevole aggiustamento rispetto alla sua valutazione massima di 45 , 6 miliardi di dollari nel 2021 . 
 tuttavia , il percorso verso la quotazione pubblica è stato costellato di sfide . all ’ inizio di aprile 2025 , in mezzo a crescenti tensioni commerciali globali e all ’ imposizione di dazi pesanti da parte dell ’ amministrazione statunitense , klarna ha deciso di sospendere i suoi piani di ipo . le condizioni di mercato volatili , aggravate dalle paure di una recessione e dalle misure di ritorsione da parte dei partner commerciali , hanno spinto l ’ azienda a ri considerare il suo tempismo . 
 nonostante questi contrattempi , la salute finanziaria di klarna rimane robusta . l ’ azienda ha riportato un aumento del 24 % delle entrate , riflettendo la sua continua espansione e la crescente popolarità dei servizi bnpl . inoltre , klarna è stata proattiva nell ’ utilizzare l ’ intelligenza artificiale per migliorare l ’ efficienza operativa , riducendo notevolmente la sua forza lavoro attraverso soluzioni di servizio clienti basate sull ’ ia . 
 mentre klarna naviga tra le complessità dell ’ attuale panorama economico , il suo eventuale debutto pubblico è molto atteso . la capacità dell ’ azienda di adattarsi alle dinamiche di mercato , unita al suo impegno per l ’ innovazione , la posiziona come un attore formidabile nel settore fintech . investitori e osservatori del settore seguiranno con attenzione gli aggiornamenti sul percorso di ipo di klarna , riconoscendo il suo potenziale di influenzare significativamente il futuro dei pagamenti digitali . 
 8. chime 
 chime , fondata nel 2012 da chris britt e ryan king , è emersa rapidamente come un attore leader nel settore bancario digitale of frendo servizi finanziari senza commissioni e centrati sul mobile . l ’ approccio innovativo dell ’ azienda ha attratto una base clienti sostanziale , con oltre 22 milioni di utenti alla fine del 2024 . il successo di chime è attribuito principalmente alla sua piattaforma user - friendly , che offre funzionalità come il deposito diretto anticipato , il risparmio automatico e l ’ assenza di commissioni bancarie tradizionali , risu on ando particolarmente con le demografie più giovani in cerca di soluzioni bancarie convenienti e a basso costo . 
 nel dicembre 2024 , chime ha presentato in modo riservato una domanda per un ’ offerta pubblica iniziale ( ipo ) , puntando a diventare pubblica nel 2025 . l ’ azienda era stata valutata a 25 miliardi di dollari nel 2021 dopo aver assicurato 750 milioni di dollari in un round di finanziamento di serie g guidato da sequoia capital . tuttavia , all ’ inizio di aprile 2025 , chime , insieme ad altre aziende tecnologiche come klarna e stubhub , ha deciso di sospendere i suoi piani di ipo a causa della volatilità del mercato e dell ’ incertezza degli investitori derivante dai nuovi dazi annuncia ti e dalle crescenti tensioni commerciali globali . nonostante queste sfide , chime continua a concentrarsi sull ’ espansione delle sue offerte di prodotti e sul miglioramento dell ’ esperienza del cliente , posizionandosi come un attore significativo nella transizione in corso dalla banca tradizionale ai servizi finanziari mobile - first . 
 9. medline industries 
 medline industries , fondata nel 1966 dai fratelli james e jon mills , è evoluta in un importante produttore e distributore globale di forniture mediche , of frendo un ampio portafoglio di circa 335 . 000 prodotti . l ’ azienda opera in oltre 100 paesi e territori , supportata da una forza lavoro che supera i 43 . 000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo . nel 2024 , medline ha riportato vendite nette di 25,5 miliardi di dollari , segnando oltre 50 anni consecutivi di crescita dei ricavi . 
 nel dicembre 2024 , medline ha presentato in modo riservato una domanda per un ’ offerta pubblica iniziale ( ipo ) negli stati uniti , puntando a raccogliere più di 5 miliardi di dollari . questa mossa potrebbe potenzialmente valutare l ’ azienda a circa 50 miliardi di dollari . l ’ ipo era prevista per avvenire già nel secondo trimestre del 2025 , a condizione delle condizioni di mercato . 
 tuttavia , ad aprile 2025 , medline , insieme ad altre aziende come klarna e stubhub , ha deciso di posticipare i suoi piani di ipo a causa della volatilità del mercato derivante dai nuovi dazi statunitensi e dalle crescenti tensioni commerciali globali . questa decisione riflette l ’ approccio prudente dell ’ azienda nel navigare in paesaggi economici incerti . 
 la costante traiettoria di crescita di medline e la sua ampia presenza globale sottolineano il suo ruolo significativo nel settore sanitario . il potenziale debutto pubblico dell ’ azienda rimane un punto focale per gli osservatori del settore e gli investitori , poiché potrebbe rappresentare una delle ipo più sostanziali nell ’ industria delle forniture mediche negli ultimi anni . 
 cosa rende queste ipo uniche ? 
 queste aziende si distinguono per la loro forte equità di marca , la rapida crescita dei ricavi e la leadership di settore . inoltre , molte operano in settori ad alta crescita come fintech , ia , tecnologia spaziale e energia verde , aree favorite da investitori istituzionali e al dettaglio . 
 tendenze chiave che guidano l ’ attività ipo nel 2025 
 diverse tendenze macro stanno accelerando il pipeline delle ipo . queste includono la normalizzazione dei tassi di interesse , il miglioramento della stabilità del mercato e la domanda accumulata da parte delle aziende che hanno ritardato la quotazione pubblica durante il calo del 2022 - 2023 . l’appetito degli investitori sta tornando , specialmente per modelli di business scalabili e guidati dalla tecnologia . 
 consigli per gli investitori : cosa osservare nelle ipo 
 quando si valutano le ipo in arrivo , considera le performance finanziarie , la dimensione del mercato , il vantaggio competitivo e l ’ esperienza della gestione . leggi attentamente il filing s - 1 , concentrando ti sulla crescita dei ricavi , sulla traiettoria di redditività e su eventuali rischi legali o normativi . 
 rischi da tenere a mente 
 non tutte le ipo sono garantite come vincenti . il tempismo di mercato , le valutazioni elevate e i modelli di business non provati possono comportare rischi . ad esempio , alcuni unicorni hanno deluso gli investitori dopo l ’ ipo a causa di utili deboli o percorsi poco chiari verso la redditività . 
 l ’ impatto sui mercati più ampi 
 le ipo di alto profilo tendo no a migliorare il sentiment di mercato e possono portare a un aumento dell ’ attività di trading in tutti i settori . un ’ ipo di successo di stripe o spacex potrebbe sollevare le valutazioni nei settori fintech o spaziali , rispettivamente . 
 il ritorno del boom delle ipo tecnologiche ? 
 dopo un lento 2022 e un cauto 2023 - 2024 , le ipo tecnologiche sembrano pronte per un grande ritorno . con l ’ interesse per l ’ ia , l ’ automazione , l ’ infrastruttura cloud e i pagamenti digitali in accelerazione , il 2025 potrebbe segnare il ritorno di un boom delle ipo su larga scala . 
 esg e prontezza per le ipo 
 i fattori ambientali , sociali e di governance ( esg ) stanno diventando sempre più importanti per gli investitori in ipo . aziende come impossible foods e shein affrontano scrutinio non solo per la crescita , ma anche per l ’ approvvigionamento etico , le emissioni e la responsabilità sociale . 
 quotazioni internazionali e interesse degli stati uniti 
 alcune aziende potrebbero scegliere quotazioni internazionali a causa di fattori normativi o politici , ma le borse statunitensi come nasdaq e nyse rimangono altamente attraenti . gli investitori statunitensi dovrebbero anche prestare attenzione alle ipo transfrontaliere che offrono esposizione globale . 
 conclusione 
 il 2025 si preannuncia come un anno straordinario per le ipo , con molte aziende che definiscono il settore pronte a diventare pubbliche . per gli investitori , questo presenta sia opportunità che sfide : la possibilità di investire nei giganti di domani , ma anche la necessità di diligenza e gestione del rischio . rimani informato , leggi attentamente i filing e considera il valore a lungo termine rispetto all ’ hype a breve termine .

8.title: 2025年のIPO市場はどうなる?サラリーマン投資家が狙うべき新規上場銘柄 - TF Online
8.content:
投資 ・ 株式 
 2025 年 の ipo 市場 は どう なる ？ サラリーマン 投資家 が 狙う べき 新規 上場 銘柄 
 2025年 5月 17 日 （ 土 ） 
 匿名 
 要約 
 2025 年 の ipo 市場 は 、 昨年 の 動向 を 引き継ぎ 、 さらなる 進展 が 予想 されて います 。 特に 大型 ipo の 増加 や 新興 企業 の 期待 が 高まる 中 、 サラリーマン 投資家 にとって は 新規 上場 銘柄 の 選定 が 重要 な ポイント と なり ます 。 本 記事 では 、 2025 年 の ipo 市場 の 展望 や 注目 す べき 銘柄 の 選び方 を 解説 し 、 投資 戦略 を 支援 します 。 
 目次 
 2025 年 の ipo （ 新規 株式 公開 ） 市場 は 、 昨年 の 動向 を 引き継ぎ ながら も 、 さら なる 変化 が 予想 されて います 。 
 2024 年 に は 86 社 が 上場 し 、 東京メトロ や キオクシア ホールディングス な ど の 大型 ipo が 注目 銘柄 でした 。 
 一方 、 グロース 市場 の 低迷 が 続き 、 投資家 の 選別 が 厳しく なる 傾向 も 見 られ まし た 。 
 2025 年 には 、 大型 ipo に 加え 、 ポケトーク の よう な 新興 企業 の 上場 も 期待 されて います 。 
 本 記事 では 、 2025 年 の ipo 市場 の 展望 と 、 サラリーマン 投資家 が 狙う べき 新規 上場 銘柄 の 選び方 について 解説 します 。 
 1. 2025 年 の ipo 市場 は どうなる ？ 最新 トレンド と 注目 点 
 2025 年 の ipo 市場 は 、 全体 的 に 90 社 前後 の 上場 が 見込ま れ て います 。 
 2024 年 の 86 社 と ほぼ 同 水準 で 推移 する と 予測 さ れる ものの 、 いくつ か の 重要 な トレンド が 浮かび上がっ て います 。 
 1.1 大型 ipo の 増加 
 2024 年 は 東京 メトロ や キ オクシア ホールディングス など 、 時価 総額 1 , 000 億 円 超 の 大型 ipo が 相次ぎ まし た 。 
 2025 年 も e neos ホールディングス 傘下 の jx 金属 や 、 ソニー フィナンシャル グループ （ 10 月 上場 予定 ） が 市場 を 賑わせる と 考え られ ます 。 
 これ ら の 企業 は 安定 した ビジネスモデル を 持ち 、 長期 投資 の 対象 として 魅力 的 です 。 
 1.2 グロース 市場 の 改革 と 新興 企業 の ipo 
 2024 年 、 東証グロース 市場 250 指数 は 年間 で 8 . 8 % 下落 し 、 全体 として 低 迷 しま した 。 
 この 流れ を 受け 、 2025 年 には グロース 市場 の 改革 が 進め られ 、 上場 基準 の 引き上げ や 事業 成長 性 の 強化 が 求め られる 可能性 があります 。 
 これ により 、 本当に 成長 が 期待 できる 企業 のみ が ipo を 果たす こと に なり 、 投資家 にとって より 質 の 高い 銘柄 選定 が 重要 に なり ます 。 
 1.3 業種別 トレンド 
 1.3.1 ai ・ dx 関連 企業 
 企業 の デジタル 変革 が 加速 し 、 業務 効率 向上 や コスト 削減 を 実現 する ai ・ dx 技術 の 需要 が 拡大 してい ます 。 
 特に 、 クラウドサービス や ai を 活用 した データ分析 、 業務 自動化 を 提供 する 企業 の ipo が 増加 する 見込み です 。 
 加 え て 、 ai を 活用 した saas （ software as a service ） 型 ビジネス の 成長 が 加速 し 、 企業 の コスト 削減 や 業務 最適化 に 寄与 する サービス 増加 へ の 期待 が 拡大 してい ます 。 
 サラリーマン 投資家 にとって 、 成長 性 の 高い 分野 で あり ながら 、 ビジネス モデル が 分かり やすく 、 長期 的 な 投資 に 適し ている 点 が 魅力 です 。 
 1.3.2 人材 関連 サービス 
 少子 高齢化 による 労働力 不足 を 背景 に 、 スキル マッチング や フリーランス 支援 、 リスキリング を 提供 する 企業 が 注目 されて います 。 
 近年 、 企業 の dx 化 に 伴い 、 エンジニア や データ サイエン ティスト の 需要 も 増大 してい ます 。 
 これ に 対応 する 教育 ・ 人材 育成 企業 の ipo も 増加 する と 考え られ ます 。 これら の 企業 は 安定的 な 需要 を 見込める ため 、 比較的 低 リスク な 投資 対象 と なり ます 。 
 1.3.3 半導体 ・ エレクトロニクス 関連 
 5 g や iot の 普及 に 伴い 、 半導体 需要 が 拡大 してい ます 。 jx 金属 の よう に 、 半導体 材料 を 提供 する 企業 は 、 今後 の 市場 成長 に 伴い 高い 収益 性 を 期待 でき ます 。 
 特に 、 グローバル な 半導体 市場 の 動向 を 把握 する こと で 、 より 有望 な 投資 機会 を 見出せる でしょ う 。 
 また 、 次世代 半導体 技術 の 開発 が 進む 中 で 、 関連 する 製造 装置 や 材料 供給 企業 も ipo の 候補 と なる 可能性 があります 。 
 1.3.4 金融 業界 （ 銀行 ・ 保険 ） 
 2025 年 は 、 日本 銀行 の 金融 政策 に 変化 が 生じる 可能性 が 指摘 されて います 。 
 特に マイナス 金利 政策 の 解除 や 金利 引き上げ の 議論 が 進め ば 、 銀行 や 保険 業界 に 大きな 影響 を 与える でしょ う 。 
 2. サラリーマン 投資家 が 狙う べき 新規 上場 銘柄 の 選び方 
 ipo 投資 は 、 大きな 利益 を 得る チャンス があります が 、 適切 な 銘柄 選定 が 不可欠です 。 
 特に 、 サラリーマン 投資家 にとって は 「 中 長期 で 成長 が 期待 できる か 」 ・ 「 リスク 管理 が 可能 か 」 が 重要 な 観点 です 。 
 限ら れ た 資金 と 時間 の 中 で 最大 の リターン を 得る ため に 、 慎重 な 選択 が 求め られ ます 。 
 2.1 企業 の 成長 性 と 業界 トレンド を 確認 
 投資 対象 の 企業 が 属する 業界 の 成長 性 を チェック する こと が 重要 。 例えば 、 2025 年 には 次 の よう な 企業 が 注目 されて います 。 
 1 つ 目 は jx 金属 です 。 
 銅 製錬 大手 で あり 、 半導体 材料 の 製造 に も 携わる 企業 です 。 半導体 市場 の 成長 により 、 今後 の 需要 拡大 が 期待 されます 。 
 特に 、 半導体 供給 網 の 安定 化 が 世界 的 に 求め られ て おり 、 長期 的 に 安定 し た 収益 基盤 を 確保 できる 可能性 が 高い でしょ う 。 
 2 つ 目 は ポケトーク （ 2025 年中 に 上場 予定 ） です 。 
 携帯 翻訳機 を 展開 する 企業 で 、 イン バウンド 需要 の 回復 や ビジネス の グローバル 化 により 、 翻訳 技術 の 需要 が 増加 中 です 。 
 特に 、 観光業 や 企業 の 海外 展開 を サポート する ツール として の 成長 が 見込ま れ て います 。 
 3 つ 目 は ビットバンク （ 2025 年中 に 上場 予定 ） です 。 
 日本 国内 で 暗号 資産 取引所 を 運営 してい ます 。 
 デジタル 資産 の 認知 度 向上 や 、 中央 銀行 デジタル 通貨 （ cbd c ） の 議論 が 進む 中 で 、 暗号 資産 市場 の 成長 ポテンシャル に 期待 が 集まり ます 。 
 特に 、 日本 国内 で 規制 強化 が 進む 中 、 適正 な 管理 体制 を 持つ 取引所 が 成長 する 可能性 があります 。 
 4 つ 目 は ソニー フィナンシャル グループ （ 10 月 上場 予定 ） です 。 
 ソニーグループ が 保 有 する 金融 子会社 で 、 ソニー生命 、 ソニー損保 、 ソニー銀行 を 運営 し てい ます 。 
 2025 年 の スピンオフ （ 事業 分離 ） 上場 を 計画 し て おり 、 金融 業界 における 再編 の 一環 として 注目 されます 。 
 サラリーマン 投資家 にとって 、 長期 的 に 安定 し た 配当 が 期待 できる 点 も 魅力 です 。 
 特に 低 金利 環境 が 終わり つつ ある 中 で 、 銀行 ・ 保険 事業 の 収益 拡大 が 見込ま れ て います 。 
 2.2 ipo の 公開 価格 と 市場 評価 を 分析 
 ipo 株 は 、 公開 価格 と 初値 の 動向 を 確認 する こと が 重要 です 。 
 過去 の データ から も 、 公開 価格 が 高 すぎる と 初値 割れ する ケース が 多い ため 、 適正 な 評価 が されて いるか を チェック しま しょう 。 
 2.3 証券会社 の 主幹 事 情報 を 活用 
 ipo に 当選 し やすく するために 、 主 幹事 証券 会社 の 口座 を 開設 し て おく の も 戦略 の 一つ です 。 2024 年 の 主 幹事 証券 ランキング では 、 
 1 位 ： smbc日興証券 （ 23 件 ） 
 2 位 ： みずほ証券 （ 19 件 ）

 と なって おり 、 これら の 証券 会社 を 活用 する こと で ipo 投資 の 機会 を 増やせ ます 。 
 3. まとめ 
 2025 年 の ipo 市場 は 、 前年 と 同 水準 の 90 社 程度 の 上場 が 予想 さ れ 、 特に jx 金属 や ソニー フィナンシャル グループ といった 大型 ipo が 注目 銘柄 です 。 
 一方 で 、 グロース 市場 の 低迷 が 続い て おり 、 市場 改革 の 動向 を フォロー し ながら ipo 投資 に 慎重 な 銘柄 選定 を し たい ところ です 。 
 サラリーマン 投資家 が 狙う べき ポイント を お さらいしましょ う 。

 getting ready for the big ipo boom 
 earlier this year , i remember chatting with a friend about how crazy the ipo market was getting . we were both kind of amazed by how many companies were going public . anyway , that got me thinking : what ’s the deal with all these ipos ? are they really worth all the hype ? 
 so , let ’s clear something up first . not all ipos are created equal . some are hyped up for good reason , while others … notsomuch . butwith2025shapinguptobeabigyearforipos,it’sworthtakingacloserlookatwhat’scomingdownthepipeline . thisis n't ju st aboutbigna mes  andflashyheadlines;it'saboutunderstandingwhattheseiposmeanforinvestorsandthemarketasawhole . 
 in this post , we ’re going to look at some of the most anticipated ipos of 2025 . we ’ll talk about why they matter , what to expect , and how to sort through all the noise . anyway , let ’s get started . 
 the big names to watch 
 tech giants leading the charge 
 first up , let ’s talk about the tech giants . these are the companies that have been making waves for a while now , and they ’re finally ready to go public . one of the biggest names on the list is quantum leap technologies . they ’ve been working on some pretty amazing stuff in the world of quantum computing . their tech is supposed to be a game - changer , making computers way faster and more efficient . 
 another big player is skynet solutions . they ’re all about cybersecurity , which is a huge deal these days . with all the data breaches and hacking attempts , companies are looking for better ways to protect themselves . skynet ’s solutions are supposed to be top - notch , so their ipo is definitely one to watch . 
 also , don't forget about ecofusion energy . they 're focused on renewable energy , which is a big deal right now . with climate change being a major concern , companies that can provide clean energy solutions are going to be in high demand . 
 healthcare and biotech : the next big thing 
 next up , we’ve got healthcare and biotech . these industries have been booming lately , and for good reason . biogenix pharmaceuticals is one of the most talked - about companies in this space . they ’ve been working on some groundbreaking treatments for rare diseases , and their ipo is expected to be a big one . 
 another company to keep an eye on is meditech innovations . they ’re all about medical technology , like advanced surgical tools and diagnostic equipment . with the healthcare industry always looking for better tools , meditech ’s ipo could be a major event . 
 also , greenleaf therapeutics is making waves in the biotech world . they ’re focused on developing plant-based therapies , which is a growing trend in the healthcare industry . 
 fintech : changing the game

 another fintech company to watch is cryptoguard . they specialize in cryptocurrency security , which is a huge deal right now . with all the issues around crypto theft and fraud , companies that can offer better security solutions are in high demand . 
 also , investease is making waves in the investment world . they offer a platform that makes it easier for people to invest in stocks and other assets . with more people looking to invest their money , investease ’s ipo could be a big deal . 
 why these ipos matter 
 so , why should you care about these ipos ? well , for one thing , they can be a great opportunity for investors . when a company goes public , it means you can buy shares and potentially make a profit if the company does well . but it ’s not just about making money . these ipos also tell us a lot about where the market is headed . 
 for example , the fact that so many tech and healthcare companies are going public shows that these industries are booming . it means that there ’s a lot of innovation happening , and that ’s a good thing for everyone . plus , it can give us a clue about what kinds of products and services we can expect to see in the future . 
 another reason these ipos matter is because they can have a big impact on the economy . when companies go public , they often raise a lot of money . that money can be used to create jobs , invest in new technologies , and drive economic growth . so , even if you ’re not an investor , these ipos can still affect you in a big way . 
 anyway , the way i see it ( but i could be wrong ) , these ipos are a sign that the market is healthy and growing . that ’s a good thing for everyone , whether you ’re an investor or not . 
 what to expect from these ipos 
 so , what can we expect from these ipos ? well , for one thing , there ’s going to be a lot of hype . companies going public is a big deal , and everyone wants to know what ’s going to happen . you can expect to see a lot of news coverage , a lot of analysis , and a lot of speculation . 
 but here ’s the thing : not all of that hype is going to be accurate . in fact , a lot of it might be way off base . that ’s why it ’s important to do your own research and make your own decisions . don’t just rely on what you hear in the news or read online . take the time to really understand what these companies are about and what they ’re offering . 
 another thing to expect is volatility . when a company goes public , its stock price can go up and down a lot . that ’s just the nature of the market . so , if you ’re thinking about investing in any of these ipos , be prepared for some ups and downs . it ’s all part of the process . 
 that said , there are some things you can do to minimize the risk . for one thing , you can diversify your investments . don’t put all your money into one company or one industry . spread it out so that if one investment doesn’t do well , you’ve still got others to fall back on . 
 also , pay attention to the company ’s financials . look at their earnings reports , their revenue , their profits . all of that stuff can give you a good idea of how the company is doing and whether it ’s a good investment . anyway , the point is , do your homework . don’t just jump in without knowing what you ’re getting into . 
 how to sort through the noise 
 with so many ipos coming up , it can be hard to sort through all the noise and figure out which ones are worth paying attention to . but there are some things you can do to make it easier . 
 first , pay attention to the company ’s track record . have they been successful in the past ? do they have a good reputation in their industry ? these things can give you a good idea of whether the company is likely to do well in the future . 
 another thing to look at is the company ’s business model . how do they make money ? is it a sustainable model that ’s likely to last ? or is it something that ’s just a fad that ’s going to fade away ? understanding the business model can help you figure out whether the company is a good long - term investment .

 anyway , the point is , don’t just rely on the hype . do your own research and make your own decisions . that ’s the best way to sort through all the noise and figure out which ipos are worth paying attention to . 
 wrapping it up

# Smart Home Market: Trends, Growth, and Future Outlook  

The global smart home market is undergoing rapid transformation, driven by technological advancements, shifting consumer preferences, and increasing demand for convenience and energy efficiency. This report provides a data-driven analysis of the market, focusing on current trends, growth potential, and strategic opportunities.  

---

## Market Overview  
A **smart home** integrates IoT devices, AI, and automation to enhance residential living through interconnected systems for security, energy management, and entertainment. Key components include smart thermostats, voice assistants, and automated lighting systems.  

The market has evolved significantly since the early 2010s, with affordability and adoption rates surging. By 2024, the global smart home market was valued at **$1,042.8 billion**, projected to grow at a **CAGR of 12.02%**, reaching **$2,896.4 billion by 2033** 【6】. In the U.S., 6,991 million households actively use smart home devices in 2024, a 10.2% increase from 2023 【1】.  

---

## Market Segmentation  
The market is segmented into product categories, consumer demographics, and regional preferences:  

### **Product Segmentation**  
| Category                  | Market Share (2024) | Key Trends                                  |  
|---------------------------|---------------------|---------------------------------------------|  
| Home Security Systems     | 32%                 | Rising demand for AI-driven surveillance    |  
| Energy Management         | 25%                 | Growth in IoT-enabled smart thermostats     |  
| Smart Appliances          | 20%                 | Voice-activated devices dominate            |  
| Entertainment Devices     | 15%                 | Integration with streaming platforms        |  
| Others                    | 8%                  | Expansion in home healthcare solutions      |  
*(Data sources: 【1】【6】【9】)*  

### **Consumer Demographics**  
- **Age**: 18–44 years dominate adoption, with 70% of U.S. households owning at least one smart device by 2022 【2】.  
- **Income**: High-income households (>$75,000) account for 65% of purchases in North America 【4】.  
- **Region**: APAC leads growth (CAGR of 15%), driven by urbanization in China and India, while North America remains the largest market 【3】【7】.  

---

## Competitive Landscape  
The market is dominated by tech giants and specialized players:  

### **Top 3 Market Leaders**  
| Company               | Strengths                                      | Weaknesses                                  |  
|-----------------------|------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------|  
| **Amazon**            | 1. Ecosystem integration (Alexa, Echo).        | 1. High device costs for premium models.    |  
|                       | 2. Strong B2C partnerships.                    | 2. Privacy concerns with voice data.        |  
|                       | 3. Extensive third-party app compatibility.    | 3. Limited hardware customization.          |  
| **Samsung**           | 1. SmartThings platform leadership.           | 1. Complex setup for non-smartphones.       |  
|                       | 2. Diverse product portfolio (smart TVs, fridges). | 2. Higher price points compared to rivals.   |  
|                       | 3. Strong R&D in AI and IoT.                   |                                             |  
| **LG**                | 1. Acquisition of Athom (Homey platform).     | 1. Limited market share in emerging regions. |  
|                       | 2. Energy-efficient appliances.                | 2. Slower response to interoperability demands. |  
|                       | 3. Strategic focus on AI-driven solutions.     |                                             |  
*(Sources: 【5】【9】)*  

### **Innovators to Watch**  
1. **Athom (acquired by LG)**: Its open-source Homey platform enables cross-ecosystem interoperability, addressing a key market pain point 【5】.  
2. **Startups like Ecobee**: Specializing in energy-efficient smart thermostats with AI learning capabilities, targeting eco-conscious consumers 【6】.  

---

## Technological Trends and Innovations  
Emerging technologies are reshaping the smart home landscape:  

### **Key Innovations**  
1. **AI and Machine Learning**:  
   - Enables predictive maintenance and adaptive learning (e.g., adjusting HVAC settings based on user behavior) 【2】【6】.  
   - 60% of new smart devices now include AI-powered voice assistants 【2】.  

2. **Interoperability**:  
   - Platforms like Matter (supported by Apple, Google, and Amazon) aim to unify device compatibility, reducing fragmentation 【2】【9】.  

3. **5G Connectivity**:  
   - Low-latency networks enable real-time security monitoring and seamless device synchronization 【8】.  

4. **Voice and Gesture Control**:  
   - Voice-activated systems now account for 40% of smart home interactions, with gesture control gaining traction in luxury markets 【4】.  

---

## Market Drivers and Challenges  
### **Drivers**  
- **Consumer Demand**: 75% of users prioritize convenience, with 60% citing energy savings as a key motivator 【4】【6】.  
- **Affordability**: Smart device prices have dropped by 30% since 2020, expanding accessibility 【1】.  
- **Sustainability**: 55% of consumers prefer energy-efficient solutions, boosting demand for smart thermostats and lighting 【6】.  

### **Challenges**  
- **Privacy Concerns**: 45% of users cite data security as a barrier to adoption 【5】.  
- **High Costs**: Entry-level systems average $500–$1,000, limiting mass-market penetration 【4】.  
- **Integration Complexity**: 30% of users struggle with device compatibility across ecosystems 【9】.  

---

## Future Outlook and Opportunities  
The market is projected to reach **$8,519 billion by 2032** (CAGR of 25.5%) 【9】, with APAC leading growth due to urbanization and government incentives.  

### **Opportunities for Innovation**  
1. **AI-Driven Personalization**: Customizable automation workflows based on user behavior.  
2. **Energy Efficiency Solutions**: Smart grids and solar integration to meet sustainability goals.  
3. **Healthcare Integration**: Wearables linked to smart homes for elderly care monitoring.  

---

## Strategic Recommendations  
1. **Invest in Interoperability**: Prioritize Matter certification to reduce user friction.  
2. **Leverage AI for User Experience**: Develop predictive analytics to enhance device functionality.  
3. **Target Affordable Segments**: Launch budget-friendly devices to expand market reach in emerging economies.  

---  

The smart home market is poised for exponential growth, driven by technological convergence and evolving consumer needs. Stakeholders must address privacy, affordability, and integration challenges to capitalize on this $8.5 trillion opportunity by 2032.

 歴史的 な 期間 に 、 手頃 な 価格 の スマートデバイス の 普及 が スマート ホーム 市場 の 成長 を 促進 し まし た 。 手頃 な 価格 の スマートデバイス の 普及 は 、 スマート ホーム 技術 を より 幅広い 消費者 が 利用 し やすく し 、 普及率 の 上昇 を 促し て います 。 コスト が 下がる こと で 、 より 多く の 家庭 が スマート オートメーション 、 セキュリティ 、 エネルギー 管理 ソリューション を 統合 できる よう に なり 、 利便性 、 効率性 、 生活 水準 全体 が 向上 します 。 例えば 、 2023 年 には 、 スマート ウォッチ 、 スマート 冷蔵庫 、 コネ ク テッド サーモ スタット の 所有率 が 上昇 し 、 スマートデバイス の 採用 が 拡大 し 続け た 。 例えば 、 ドロップ シッピングアプリ oberlo の 調査 による 最新 の スマート ホーム 統計 による と 、 2024 年 には 米国 で 6 , 991 万 もの 世帯 が スマート ホーム デバイス を 積極的 に 使用 し ている と 報告 されて います 。 これ は 2023 年 に 記録 された 6 , 343 万 世帯 を 10 . 2 ％ 上回る 。 したがっ て 、 手頃 な 価格 の スマートデバイス の 普及 が スマート ホーム 市場 の 成長 を 牽引 し まし た 。

 a smart home is a residence equipped with devices that are connected through a network ( often the internet ) to allow remote management and monitoring . these devices , also known as smart devices or home automation devices , can include smart speakers , thermostats , lights , security cameras , door locks and appliances . the primary goal of a smart home is to improve convenience , security , energy efficiency and comfort by allowing users to control various aspects of their home environment through a smartphone app , voice commands or automated settings . 
 the smart homes market consists of sales , by entities ( organizations , sole traders and partnerships ) , of smart home solutions ( products , software and services ) that enable automation , remote control and monitoring of home functions for convenience , security and energy efficiency . 
 the global smart homes market was valued at $ 64 , 851 . 08 million in 2019 which grew till 2024 at a compound annual growth rate ( cagr ) of more than 14 . 00 % . 
 proliferation of affordable smart devices 
 during the historic period , the proliferation of affordable smart devices propelled the growth of the smart homes market . the proliferation of affordable smart devices makes smart home technology more accessible to a broader range of consumers , driving higher adoption rates . lower costs enable more households to integrate smart automation , security and energy management solutions , enhancing convenience , efficiency and overall living standards . for example , in 2023 , the adoption of smart devices continued to grow , with an increase in the ownership of smartwatches , smart refrigerators and connected thermostats . for example , according to the latest smart home statistics from a survey by oberlo , a dropshipping app reported that as many as 69 . 91 million households in the usa are actively using smart home devices in 2024 . this is 10 . 2 % more than in the 63 . 43 million recorded in 2023. therefore , the proliferation of affordable smart devices drove the growth of the smart homes market .

2.title: Exploring Smart Home Market Trends for 2025 Innovations
2.content:
exploring smart home market trends for 2025 innovations 
 insights into tech shifts shaping smart home growth in 2025 
 sarah lee ai generated gpt - 4 o - search - preview 0 min read · april 9 , 2025 
 photo by brina blum on up splash 
 introduction 
 the smart home ecosystem has undergone a remarkable transformation over the past decade , evolving from niche gadgets to integral components of modern living . as we approach 2025 , understanding the prevailing market trends becomes crucial for consumers , manufacturers , and investors alike . this article aims to provide a comprehensive overview of the current state of the smart home market , highlight emerging technological innovations , analyze economic factors influencing the industry , and offer strategic insights for stakeholders navigating this dynamic landscape . 
 current market trends 
 overview of current industry trends 
 the smart home market is experiencing unprecedented growth , with projections estimating its value to reach $ 174 billion by 2025 . ( smartnest tech . com ) this surge is driven by advancements in the internet of things ( iot ) and artificial intelligence ( ai ) , which have enhanced device functionality and user experience . key trends include : 
 increased device adoption : approximately 70 % of u.s. households had at least one smart device by 2022 , indicating a significant shift towards connected living . ( smartnest tech . com ) 
 integration of ai and iot : the convergence of ai and iot technologies has led to more intuitive and responsive smart home systems , capable of learning user behaviors and automating tasks accordingly . 
 consumer behavior and adoption rates 
 consumer interest in smart home technologies is on the rise , with a notable willingness to invest in these innovations : 
 premium pricing : over 25 % of americans are willing to pay an average of $ 18 , 056 extra for a smart home , reflecting the perceived value of enhanced convenience and efficiency . ( vivint . com ) 
 resale value perception : 62 % of consumers believe that smart features increase a home ’s resale value , indicating a long - term investment perspective . ( vivint . com ) 
 influence of technological advancements 
 technological progress has been a catalyst for the smart home market ’s expansion : 
 standardization efforts : the development of the “ matter ” standard aims to ensure interoperability among devices from different manufacturers , simplifying the user experience and fostering broader adoption . ( smartnest tech . com ) 
 enhanced security features : with growing concerns over privacy and cybersecurity , manufacturers are integrating advanced security protocols , including biometric authentication and ai - driven surveillance , to protect user data and ensure device integrity . ( sanctu airy . wordpress . com ) 
 emerging technological innovations 
 role of ai and iot in home automation 
 ai and iot are at the forefront of smart home innovation : 
 personalized automation : ai - powered assistants can learn user habits , automating lighting , heating , and entertainment systems to align with individual preferences . ( promwad . com ) 
 predictive maintenance : iot - enabled devices can monitor their own performance , alerting homeowners to potential issues before they escalate , thereby reducing maintenance costs and enhancing safety . 
 smart device interoperability 
 the push for seamless integration among smart devices is gaining momentum : 
 universal compatibility : the “ matter ” standard facilitates communication between devices from various brands , eliminating ecosystem lock - in and allowing consumers to choose products based on preference rather than compatibility constraints . ( promwad . com ) 
 simplified user experience : with interoperability , users can control multiple devices through a single interface , streamlining management and enhancing convenience . 
 security and data privacy challenges 
 as smart homes become more connected , security and privacy concerns intensify : 
 biometric access control : implementing fingerprint or facial recognition systems enhances security by ensuring that only authorized individuals can access the home . ( sanctu airy . wordpress . com ) 
 ai - enhanced surveillance : advanced cameras equipped with ai can distinguish between familiar faces and potential intruders , reducing false alarms and improving response times . ( sanctu airy . wordpress . com ) 
 market impact and economic factors 
 economic drivers behind smart home adoption 
 several economic factors are propelling the adoption of smart home technologies : 
 energy efficiency : smart devices can optimize energy usage , leading to cost savings and appealing to environmentally conscious consumers . 
 aging population : with an increasing number of elderly individuals seeking to maintain independence , smart home technologies offer solutions for health monitoring and emergency assistance . 
 investment trends and market forecasts 
 the financial landscape reflects the growing confidence in the smart home sector : 
 venture capital influx : significant investments are being directed towards startups specializing in smart home innovations , indicating a robust pipeline of future products . 
 market valuation : the projected market value of $ 174 billion by 2025 underscores the sector ’s rapid growth and potential profitability . ( smartnest tech . com ) 
 competitive landscape and key players 
 the smart home market is characterized by intense competition among tech giants and emerging players : 
 major corporations : companies like apple , google , and amazon are expanding their smart home portfolios , leveraging their ecosystems to offer integrated solutions . ( ft . com ) 
 innovative startups : new entrants are introducing niche products and services , driving innovation and catering to specific consumer needs . 
 future outlook and strategies 
 predictions for the smart home market 
 looking ahead , several trends are expected to shape the smart home landscape : 
 sustainability focus : integration with renewable energy sources and development of energy - efficient devices will become more prevalent . ( techbullion . com ) 
 health and wellness integration : smart homes will increasingly incorporate health monitoring systems , offering features like air quality assessment and sleep tracking . ( to xi gon . com ) 
 opportunities for stakeholders 
 stakeholders can capitalize on the evolving market by : 
 developing interoperable products : ensuring compatibility with existing standards like “ matter ” can enhance market reach and consumer satisfaction . 
 prioritizing security : investing in robust security measures can build consumer trust and differentiate products in a crowded market . 
 keys to succeeding in the evolving market 
 success in the smart home industry will depend on : 
 user - centric design : creating intuitive and accessible interfaces will attract a broader consumer base . 
 continuous innovation : staying ahead of technological advancements and consumer trends will be crucial for maintaining a competitive edge . 
 conclusion 
 the smart home market is poised for significant growth and transformation by 2025 , driven by technological innovations , changing consumer behaviors , and economic factors . stakeholders who embrace interoperability , prioritize security , and focus on user experience will be well - positioned to thrive in this dynamic environment . as the industry continues to evolve , staying informed and adaptable will be key to harnessing the full potential of smart home technologies .
